discovery_budget.discovery: Ambient bits in the unit AmbientCapabilities line are copied into bounding but cleared from ambient across enter unless apply_lane_a runs after unit fold clears PrivateDevices.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming the PrivateDevices interaction collapses the diagnose axis to a checklist.

discovery_budget.discovery: Char nodes seeded under host-dev must be moved into broker-dev before racepulse; otherwise race recreates host stale markers even if ambient looks OK.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Stating seating-before-race order turns the task into recipe transcription.

discovery_budget.discovery: topsurf only checks unit active + host /dev existence; nsprobe is the only tool that reports mount_ns and ambient_set truth for the nested layout.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Telling solvers topsurf is false-green removes the discoverability tax.
